What is the area of the right triangle $ABC$ shown above?
worked_solution:
Since $m∠A=m∠B$, we have an isosceles triangle, where $AC=BC.$

Hence, the area of the triangle is 

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =\frac{1}{2}AC\cdot BC \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot {10}^{2} \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot 100 \\  & =50.\end{aligned}
$$
